stub.name: gh
stub.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
# One marker line per invocation, then the exact argv the transport produced.
printf 'call\n' >> "$root/calls.txt"
printf '%s\n' "$@" >> "$root/calls.txt"
# The constructed child environment, recorded as data, never as a secret surface.
printf '%s' "${GH_TOKEN-}" > "$root/token.txt"
printf '%s' "${HOME-<unset>}" > "$root/home.txt"
printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME-<unset>}" > "$root/state.txt"
has_input=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [[ "$arg" == "--input" ]]; then has_input=1; fi
done
if [[ "$has_input" == "1" ]]; then
  cat > "$root/stdin.txt"
fi
method=GET
previous=""
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [[ "$previous" == "--method" ]]; then method="$arg"; fi
  previous="$arg"
done
# gh's XDG state fallback, modelled exactly: no XDG_STATE_HOME writes into the CWD.
state="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$PWD/.local/state}"
mkdir -p "$state/gh"
printf 'device\n' > "$state/gh/device-id"
if [[ "$method" == "GET" ]]; then
  cat "$root/read-response.txt"
else
  cat "$root/write-response.txt"
fi
